summary: Klamath Forest Protective Association lookout at Bly: a 1934 platform on a warehouse roof at the KFPA station; the Weebly page marks it removed.

facts.design: platform on the roof of a warehouse at the Klamath Forest Protective Association station in Bly (1934); a platform over a building at the KFPA Bly headquarters
facts.status_note: The Weebly page marks this lookout as removed, with no date. No source describes what remains of the platform at the station today.

A regular lookout was stationed at Bly (June 3, 1931 item from The Evening Herald, quoted on the Weebly page)
Platform on the roof of a warehouse at the KFPA Bly station
Minor blaze on the Richardson Ranch near Bly, sighted from the Bly lookout (June 11, 1935 Klamath Herald item, quoted on the Weebly page)
Bly Guard Station closed down, per a 1967 Klamath District ODF annual report quoted on the Weebly page; the page does not link this closure to the lookout

notes_for_editor: The KFPA platform is the first lookout in Bly per NHLR and FFLOS. The 1931 'regular lookout' newspaper item and the 1934 platform date may describe the same lookout; no source says so. The KFPA station closure is dated only to the 'mid 1950s', so no closure event was added. The 1967 Bly Guard Station closure is quoted by Weebly without a link to the lookout; it is recorded as an 'other' event, not as this lookout's end. The record's coordinates (42.39799, -121.04287) are the same as the other Bly records and sit at the Ranger Station area; the register places the KFPA station a short distance east of the Forest Service station, so the point may need adjusting by a human.
